    14  /-!
    15  # Formal (multivariate) power series
    16  
    17  This file defines multivariate formal power series
    18  and develops the basic properties of these objects.
    19  
    20  A formal power series is to a polynomial like an infinite sum is to a finite sum.
    21  
    22  We provide the natural inclusion from multivariate polynomials to multivariate formal power series.
    23  
    24  ## Main definitions
    25  
    26  - `MvPowerSeries.C`: constant power series
    27  
    28  - `MvPowerSeries.X`: the indeterminates
    29  
    30  - `MvPowerSeries.coeff`, `MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff`:
    31    the coefficients of a `MvPowerSeries`, its constant coefficient
    32  
    33  - `MvPowerSeries.monomial`: the monomials
    34  
    35  - `MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul`: computes the coefficients of the product of two `MvPowerSeries`
    36  
    37  - `MvPowerSeries.coeff_prod` : computes the coefficients of products of `MvPowerSeries`
    38  
    39  - `MvPowerSeries.coeff_pow` : computes the coefficients of powers of a `MvPowerSeries`
    40  
    41  - `MvPowerSeries.coeff_eq_zero_of_constantCoeff_nilpotent`: if the constant coefficient
    42    of a `MvPowerSeries` is nilpotent, then some coefficients of its powers are automatically zero
    43  
    44  - `MvPowerSeries.map`: apply a `RingHom` to the coefficients of a `MvPowerSeries` (as a `RingHom`).
    45  
    46  - `MvPowerSeries.X_pow_dvd_iff`, `MvPowerSeries.X_dvd_iff`: equivalent
    47    conditions for (a power of) an indeterminate to divide a `MvPowerSeries`
    48  
    49  - `MvPolynomial.toMvPowerSeries`: the canonical coercion from `MvPolynomial` to `MvPowerSeries`
    50  
    51  
    52  ## Note
    53  
    54  This file sets up the (semi)ring structure on multivariate power series:
    55  additional results are in:
    56  * `Mathlib/RingTheory/MvPowerSeries/Inverse.lean` : invertibility,
    57    formal power series over a local ring form a local ring;
    58  * `Mathlib/RingTheory/MvPowerSeries/Trunc.lean`: truncation of power series.
    59  
    60  In `Mathlib/RingTheory/PowerSeries/Basic.lean`, formal power series in one variable
"}]
